versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00201, SRS_Rte_00167 For each RTE API which is subject to variability and which variability shall be imple- mented and which is following the form entity internal in [SWS_Rte_07701] the RTE Configuration Header File shall contain one definition of a Condition Value #define Rte_VPCon_<cts>_<re>[_<resl>]_<ki>_<name>_<sl> <value> where <cts> is the component type symbol of the AtomicSwComponentType , <re> is the short name of the RunnableEntity , <resl> is the shortLabel of the RunnableEntity ’s VariationPoint containing the reference element (e.g. a VariableAccess ) to the PortInterface element, <ki> is the kind infix according [SWS_Rte_07701] and <name> is the short name of the element which is subject to variability in [SWS_Rte_07701] and is defining the API name infix. <sl> is the shortLabel of the elements’ VariationPoint defining the API name infix. If there is no VariationPoint at the RunnableEntity owning the reference ele- ment (e.g. a VariableAccess ) to the PortInterface element the <resl> with leading underscore is omitted ( [_<resl>] ). <value> is the evaluated value of the ConditionByFormula of the Variation- Point defining the variant existence of the RTE API in [SWS_Rte_07701].
